title: Add controlled dataset adapters for purchase/supplier dynamic reports to the generic platform
description: Extend the generic platform beyond its two Stage-1 fixtures by adding reusable IReportConfigurationDatasetProvider adapters for the purchase/supplier dynamic-report cluster: purchase-order (query IDynamicPurchaseOrderReportQuery already registered at ERP-125), supplier-aging, and supplier-exposure. Each adapter exposes a finite field whitelist, truthful grain/capability/currency-unit semantics, and the same required menu authorization + data scope as the legacy Dynamic*ReportController (reuse the existing DynamicPurchaseOrderReportRules / DynamicSupplierAgingReportRules / DynamicSupplierExposureReportRules and the legacy controller query semantics via IErpDbContext; do NOT build a new controller, designer, or exporter). Register the new providers in the existing DependencyInjection alongside the sales-order/receivable providers and add the corresponding dataset key constants to ReportConfigurationConstants. PreviewAsync must delegate to the same bounded read-only query each legacy report uses, revalidate menu/scope per request (fail-closed), and never cross-currency merge. Add unit tests that each adapter's catalog and preview mirror the legacy report semantics (menu revocation, finite fields, currency partition, paging bounds) without regressing existing catalog/preview tests. This proves the controlled-adapter mechanism scales; the migration registry marks these entries dataset-ready so later preset work can consume them.
acceptance_criteria: Purchase-order, supplier-aging, and supplier-exposure each gain a controlled dataset adapter exposing a finite authorized field whitelist and truthful grain/capability/currency-unit semantics matching their legacy dynamic report, with dataset key constants added and providers registered in the existing catalog aggregation.

Each adapter's preview reuses the legacy report's bounded read-only query and revalidates the existing menu authorization and data scope per request (fail-closed, no cross-currency merge, no new controller/designer/exporter).

Unit tests cover catalog exposure, preview parity with legacy semantics, menu revocation, currency partition, and paging bounds for all three datasets; the safe Release build and ERP.UnitTests pass without modifying existing report endpoints.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs:65 registers IDynamicPurchaseOrderReportQuery, but lines 69-70 register no corresponding IReportConfigurationDatasetProvider for purchase-order, supplier-aging, or supplier-exposure. src/ERP.Infrastructure/Reports/ReportConfigurationDatasetProvider.cs contains only SalesOrderReportConfigurationDatasetProvider and ReceivableReportConfigurationDatasetProvider (1763 lines, two classes), and src/ERP.Application/DTOs/ReportConfigurationDtos.cs:87-88 defines only DatasetSalesOrder + DatasetReceivable. The legacy DynamicPurchaseOrderReportController/DynamicSupplierAgingReportController/DynamicSupplierExposureReportController exist with dedicated routes and Dynamic*ReportRules, but none are reachable through the generic catalog, proving the controlled-adapter gap for the purchase/supplier cluster is concrete and unmigrated.
